title: Tehran Museum of Contemporary Art

terrainReference.basis: Independent Terrarium height at the mapped main visitor entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Tehran Museum of Contemporary Art footprint, museum grounds and main visitor entrance.
mapIdentity.scope: Native museum building way 601652789 and entrance node 8164794375 within named precinct way 641200650. The 103-node exterior maps the projections and recesses of the galleries.

note: Written accounts from co-designer Nader Ardalan and Archnet describe galleries sunk into their park setting, roofs stepping north, a sunken sculpture court, and copper-clad light catchers. The main hall has four light catchers and a central octagonal skylight.
